designer_intent.overall_arrangement: Create a cinematic trip hop piece with club energy using experimental sample chopping techniques to maintain interest and dynamic flow.

presetor_intent.preset_creation: Generate custom effects and layering presets to emphasize texture and cinematic mood while maintaining clarity in club settings.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum layers using granular slicing sample chops to build dynamic and punchy rhythms suited for trip hop club vibes.

bass_generator.brief: Produce bass parts utilizing loop chopping techniques to create a groovy yet experimental low-end foundation.

harmony_generator.brief: Arrange chordal textures using time stretching and slicing methods to provide cinematic harmonic depth.

melody_generator.brief: Design melodic phrases by splicing and morphing samples, ensuring experimental and cinematic characteristics.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate overall arrangement flow, energy profile, and integrate experimental sample chop techniques into the production.

presetor.brief: Craft presets balancing cinematic atmosphere with club energy emphasizing clarity, space, and texture for sample layers.

songgps.brief: Guide arrangement structure and energy curve to fit cinematic mood with club energy in a trip hop experimental context.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Process unprocessed channel audio maintaining clarity of sample chop details while supporting the cinematic and club energy aesthetic.
